title.narrative: Port Moresby Power Grid Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed Port Moresby Grid Development Project will upgrade and extend the transmission and distribution grid in the national capital, Port Moresby, thereby improving the reliability and quality of power supply to the main urban center in Papua New Guinea (PNG), improving the energy efficiency of power delivery, and enabling delivery of essential power to rapidly expanding areas of Port Moresby. A project preparation technical assistance (PPTA) will be undertaken for the due diligence of the proposed project.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 2998: 92% of contracts awarded and 97% disbursed as of 04 Jul 2025
Loan 2999: 44% of contracts awarded and 43% disbursed as of 04 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: -ADB Loan Accounting and Servicing workshop conducted in April 2018
-Procurement training conducted by ADB consultant in May 2018.
-Safeguards Training conducted by ADB in June 2018
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43197/43197-013-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/43197/43197-013-esmr-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Dec 2012: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//43197-013-png-iee-03.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1.Rouna 1 and Sirinumu HPP Technical BER initially cancelled. Rebidding commenced and Bid closed in 15 August 2018 . BER under review.CA expected in 4Q, 2018.
Issues: Scope of work for the project has increased due to the deterioration of existing plant from the 1960s and 1970s. Prolonged Bid Evaluation due to bidders not providing sufficient information as required by the Tender documents.
2.POM system survey completed. As built drawings completed. Simulation of results and field data using Sincal in progress. Technical part 90% completed with Technical Data to be compiled and verified by a Distribution Expert.
Issues: Lack of "as built drawings"in PPL achieves,took PPL PMU almost 12months to complete survey. Forex issue, USD payment took over 6 months to renew Sincal SW License
3.Kilakila substation contract awarded on 8 May 2017.
Site clearance and site office completed with services. Project team onsite. Civil works/excavation alone-more than 50% with platform design levels reached. Tower route, spots and levels completed. Final design and approval in progress with ongoing procurement.
Issues: GoPNG counterpart funding shortfall and slight delay in USD payment (forex issue)
4.-ADB Loan Accounting and Servicing workshop conducted in April 2018
-Procurement training conducted by ADB consultant in March 2018.
